name: iF-22
detailed_description:
Step into the cockpit of the future's most advanced fighter jet with iF-22, the ultimate air combat simulation experience. As a pilot of the cutting-edge F-22 Raptor, you'll be thrust into high-stakes missions across multiple theaters of war, from intense dogfights to precision ground strikes.

Dynamic, Real-World Campaigns: Engage in a series of highly realistic, branching campaign scenarios influenced by real-world geopolitical tensions. Your strategic choices and combat performance will directly shape the battlefield, with missions ranging from deep reconnaissance and escort duties to all-out air superiority warfare.

Advanced Avionics & Weapon Systems: Master the sophisticated avionics and weapon systems of the F-22. Use its stealth capabilities to sneak behind enemy lines, unleash cutting-edge missiles, and take out enemy aircraft before they even know you're there.

Immersive Flight Physics & Controls: Experience the most authentic flight dynamics, where every maneuver, speed, and altitude adjustment affects your combat performance. Whether you’re a seasoned pilot or new to flight sims, iF-22 offers scalable difficulty and a wealth of customization options for your flight controls.

iF-22 blends top-tier simulation detail with action-packed combat, putting you at the controls of the world's most elite fighter jet. Are you ready to dominate the skies?

Features:

Photorealistic Terrain: Fly over incredibly detailed landscapes created from real satellite imagery and elevation data of Bosnia and Ukraine for an immersive, authentic combat experience.

Dynamic Campaign System: No two missions are ever the same. The campaign dynamically generates new objectives, making each playthrough unique.

Fully Interactive Cockpit: Every switch and control in the cockpit is fully functional and can be operated directly on-screen, offering a deeply immersive piloting experience.

Varied Game Modes: Jump straight into the action with instant missions, take on single challenges, or dive into a full campaign mode for hours of intense combat.

Comprehensive Warfare: Experience a wide variety of planes and vehicles engaging in both air and ground battles, making every mission feel like part of a larger war.

Scalable Difficulty: Whether you're a novice pilot or a seasoned ace, multiple difficulty levels allow you to tailor the challenge to your skill level.

3D Acceleration Support: Take advantage of Direct3D-compatible graphics accelerators for enhanced visual performance and smoother gameplay.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce GTX 1070 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce GTX 2060 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
